ModMetaData.name: Ideology symbols as Ideograms
ModMetaData.author: kilaXphantom, Jdalt40
ModMetaData.description:
Adds ideology symbols from the base game and VE Ideology Icons and Symbols (If you have it installed) as ideograms/ritual spots for your colonists to use as a normal ideogram.
I think the Ideograms are severely lacking in RimWorld and so I decided to reuse the textures from the ideology icons as Ideograms. I think some are hideous, wont lie, but, thats not for me to decide lol. If you want to use them go for it. I am not stopping you. Personally think these will fit SO much better than the default 8 ideograms or altars.
Massively huge thanks to Jdalt40 for basically doing all of the work. They were the one that made this mod happen a lot sooner and a lot easier than what I could have done! So huge shoutout to them.
